part.text:
Phase 2a is settled. The panel now renders errors and notes with **Marker**, expands with a 200ms height transition, clamps long tool output, and shows one **Plan** for the whole handoff rather than one per step.

Sources include MCP targets, so a run that reaches a Playwright server no longer claims it used none. See [the contract](https://example.com/docs/ui-contract) and [the audit](https://example.com/docs/audit) for the evidence behind each change.
